[element-size]
=== `<size>` Size (in a citation)

Size of a resource or object described in a bibliographic reference or related object description. The <<attribute-units,`@units`>> attribute must be used to name the units of measure (for example, minutes, hours, linear feet, pages).

#### Attributes

* <<attribute-specific-use,`@specific-use`>>
* <<attribute-units,`@units`>> (REQUIRED)
#### Base Attributes

* <<attribute-id,`@id`>>
* <<attribute-xml-base,`@xml:base`>>
* <<attribute-xml-lang,`@xml:lang`>>

#### Models and Context

#### May be contained in

<<element-element-citation,`<element-citation>`>>, <<element-mixed-citation,`<mixed-citation>`>>, <<element-related-article,`<related-article>`>>, <<element-related-object,`<related-object>`>>
#### Description

Text, numbers, or special characters, zero or more
#### Content Model

[source,xml]
....
<!ELEMENT  size         (#PCDATA %size-elements;)*                   >
....
#### Expanded Content Model

(#PCDATA)*
